{
  "subtype": "faceted_decomposition",
  "concept": "company_business_profile",
  "per_column": [
    {
      "name": "business_model_type",
      "is_constitutive_facet": true,
      "role": "facet",
      "rationale": "How a company creates and captures value (SaaS, marketplace, professional services) is a core constitutive aspect of its business profile."
    },
    {
      "name": "primary_customer_segment",
      "is_constitutive_facet": true,
      "role": "facet",
      "rationale": "Who the company serves (B2B, B2C, developers, investors) is an intrinsic aspect of the business profile and directly tied to the query."
    },
    {
      "name": "industry_vertical",
      "is_constitutive_facet": true,
      "role": "facet",
      "rationale": "The market/domain a company operates in is a legitimate descriptive facet of its business profile."
    },
    {
      "name": "product_delivery_mode",
      "is_constitutive_facet": true,
      "role": "facet",
      "rationale": "How the offering is delivered (cloud SaaS, physical product, staffing) is an aspect of the profile, but it overlaps heavily with business_model_type (cloud_SaaS mirrors SaaS, staffing mirrors staffing_recruiting)."
    },
    {
      "name": "company_stage_type",
      "is_constitutive_facet": true,
      "role": "facet",
      "rationale": "Lifecycle/maturity stage is an aspect of a company's profile, though it is more about corporate maturity than the business model/customer focus of the query; still a legitimate facet."
    },
    {
      "name": "core_value_proposition",
      "is_constitutive_facet": true,
      "role": "facet",
      "rationale": "The central benefit offered is a constitutive aspect of the business profile, but it substantially overlaps with industry_vertical and business_model_type (e.g., infrastructure_and_platform vs cloud_infrastructure/SaaS, financial_services vs fintech)."
    }
  ],
  "facet_columns": [
    "business_model_type",
    "primary_customer_segment",
    "industry_vertical",
    "product_delivery_mode",
    "company_stage_type",
    "core_value_proposition"
  ],
  "non_facet_columns": [],
  "mutual_exclusivity": 0.45,
  "exhaustiveness": 0.85,
  "rationale": "All six columns are genuine facets (parts-of) of a company business profile rather than external predictors or causes, so the meronymy claim holds. However, mutual exclusivity is weak: product_delivery_mode is largely a projection of business_model_type (cloud_SaaS/SaaS, staffing, investment_capital all co-vary), and core_value_proposition overlaps with both industry_vertical and business_model_type (infrastructure_and_platform, financial_services, security_and_compliance restate vertical/model categories). These redundancies mean several columns capture the same underlying aspect under different names. Exhaustiveness is fairly strong: business model, customer segment, vertical, delivery mode, stage, and value proposition together cover the main constitutive aspects of the profile, well addressing the query's business-model-and-customer focus, though geographic/scale dimensions are omitted."
}
